rules.text: An explicit valid destination in [TRANSFER: phone_number] wins. A bare or empty transfer uses the agent’s transfer_number.
rules.why: The destination is validated before the transfer starts. A self-target or invalid destination is refused.

rules.text: There is no number-level transfer_number setter or enforced tenant destination in the phone profile.
rules.instead: Give the correct explicit target in the inbound profile or outbound purpose. Leave the shared fallback unset or use separate agents if a wrong fallback is unacceptable.

rules.text: Outbound menu navigation can send keypad digits. Caller-entered digits on inbound are a separate input capability.
Set number voicemail controls and the message on an API-imported number. Review the effective settings before placing a voicemail-enabled call.
Use [WAIT] for a person who steps away. Use the outbound IVR sequence for a phone menu. Keep an ordinary conversation separate from either mode.
Inspect the number and its voicemail controls before changing its settings.
voicemail_message_required means an enabled leave-voicemail policy needs a nonblank message.
